title: Consultation notes
description: A short write-up of a completed visit. Save it as a draft, then sign it off when it is final.
synthetic: Synthetic data for testing only. Never enter real patient information.
gated: Consultation notes are switched off until clinical features are approved and enabled. Nothing here is saved or shown.

notCompleted.title: Notes open after the visit is completed
notCompleted.body: You can write consultation notes once this booking is marked completed.

summary.label: Visit summary
summary.hint: Why the patient was seen and what you did.

advice.label: Advice given
advice.hint: What you told the patient to do.

followUp.label: Follow-up
followUp.hint: When to review, or say that none is needed.

editor.title: Draft
editor.intro: Nothing is saved automatically. Use Save draft to keep your work; leaving with unsaved text asks first.

signOff.title: Sign off
signOff.intro: After sign-off the notes are read-only. Visit summary and advice are required.
signOff.attest: I confirm these notes are accurate and complete for this visit

errors.attest: Confirm the notes are accurate before signing off.

conflict.title: These notes changed somewhere else
conflict.body: Someone saved a newer version, or the notes were signed off. Reload to see the latest version; your unsaved text here will be lost.
